measurement.label: VERIFIED
measurement.method: Metadata probe plus decoded frames at 1 fps across every return.

selection.editDecision: [INFERRED] ACA-001 cuts directly to ACA-003; ACA-015 closes directly into ACA-001 as a lens-crossing match cut. The two held takes remain preserved but never enter the public reel.

jobs.storyEn: The rear-facing courier carries one sealed letter down the moonlit axis toward the open gate.
jobs.storyAr: يحمل الرسول ذو الظهر المواجه لنا رسالةً مختومة واحدة على محور ضوء القمر نحو البوابة المفتوحة.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the repaired rear three-quarter owl recedes toward the lit gate and finishes tiny over the stairs; the letter slips lower late but remains with the subject.
VERIFIED — the rejected frontal owl flies at the camera through the first half, then the image morph-cuts into the stairwell. It contradicts the repaired away-travel composition.

jobs.storyEn: The stair shaft rises into the library landing; architecture carries the invitation forward.
jobs.storyAr: يصعد بئر السلالم إلى بسطة المكتبة؛ وتحمل العمارة الدعوة إلى الأمام.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — clean camera-and-environment transition from stair shaft to library landing with no subject drift.

jobs.storyEn: Ten fixed lights yield to an open blank grimoire and a waiting quill.
jobs.storyAr: تفسح عشرة أضواء ثابتة الطريق لكتاب تعازيم مفتوح وريشةٍ تنتظر.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — continuous rightward reveal from the library grid to the open grimoire and quill.

jobs.storyEn: One plain ink stroke leaves the page as candle-gold motes and enters the sorting glass.
jobs.storyAr: يغادر خط حبر بسيط الصفحة كذرات ذهبية مضاءة بالشموع ويدخل زجاج الفرز.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — ink lifts as restrained gold motes and resolves cleanly on the mirror destination.

jobs.storyEn: The mirror fans its current toward six silent portrait masters.
jobs.storyAr: تنشر المرآة تيارها نحو ستة من سادة الصور الصامتين.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the mirror emits the moving light motif and the camera resolves on exactly six framed portraits; intermediate thread count is not clean enough to claim exactness.

jobs.storyEn: The portrait corridor gives way to a potion chamber holding one suspended miniature tower.
jobs.storyAr: يفضي ممر الصور إلى حجرة جرعات تحمل برجًا مصغرًا واحدًا معلّقًا.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the lateral camera move preserves the six-frame corridor and lands cleanly in the potion chamber.

jobs.storyEn: A crimson cast fractures the miniature and leaves one broken red ring as evidence.
jobs.storyAr: تُحطم تعويذة قرمزية المجسم وتترك حلقة حمراء مكسورة كدليل.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the red ring forms, the miniature breaks, and the same adult wand hand remains coherent through the shot.

jobs.storyEn: The second cast lifts the same miniature and closes the ring green-gold.
jobs.storyAr: ترفع التعويذة الثانية المجسم نفسه وتغلق الحلقة بلون أخضر ذهبي.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — debris reassembles, the tower lifts, and the ring changes from broken amber to a closed green-gold proof.

jobs.storyEn: The accepted green-gold current leaves the workbench and runs toward ten standing lights.
jobs.storyAr: يغادر التيار الأخضر الذهبي المعتمد منضدة العمل ويتجه نحو عشرة أضواء معلّقة.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — one continuous current leads the camera from the proven miniature into the ten-light hall.

jobs.storyEn: Ten candles hold their grid while the camera reaches the owl-post opening beyond.
jobs.storyAr: تحافظ عشر شموع على شبكتها بينما تصل الكاميرا إلى فتحة بريد البوم خلفها.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — exactly ten candle clusters remain visible through the push; the destination contains the expected courier plus distant owl-post traffic.

jobs.storyEn: The courier banks through the opening and hands the journey to a lantern behind the restricted bars.
jobs.storyAr: ينعطف الرسول عبر الفتحة ويسلّم الرحلة إلى فانوس خلف قضبان القسم المحظور.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the owl crosses left, exits, and the camera completes the move on the restricted-section lantern without a cut.

jobs.storyEn: Behind the bars, a ruled blank ledger opens and receives one unbroken line.
jobs.storyAr: خلف القضبان ينفتح سجل مسطر فارغ ويتلقى خطًا واحدًا متصلًا.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the lantern composition yields to a blank ruled ledger and a quill draws one plain line.

jobs.storyEn: The line stops being a record and becomes the brass axis of the astronomy platform.
jobs.storyAr: يتوقف الخط عن كونه سجلًا ويصبح المحور النحاسي لمنصة الفلك.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the ledger dissolves through a restrained star field into the brass telescope platform.

jobs.storyEn: The telescope fills the frame and finds the same sealed letter returning through the moonlit lens.
jobs.storyAr: يملأ المنظار الإطار ويجد الرسالة المختومة نفسها عائدةً عبر العدسة المضيئة بالقمر.
jobs.evidence: VERIFIED — the brass lens advances cleanly and reveals the frontal owl and sealed letter as an intentional pre-cut approach.
VERIFIED — the owl remains frontal and grows toward the camera for the entire take, contradicting the repaired rear-facing away-travel opening and breaking the loop direction.
